title: CVB Recalls LUCID Folding Mattress-Sofas Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 86,000.

title: PurpleAir Recalls Power Supply Units for Air Sensors Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The power supplies can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 4,200 sold in the United States (in addition, about 172 were sold in Canada).

title: Shop LC Recalls Disco Ball LED Light Due to Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The battery can overheat while charging, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 5,000.

title: Target Recalls Toddler Boots Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The unicorn horn on the boot can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 33,600.

title: Delta Electronics Recalls Solar Inverters Due to Fire and Impact Hazards
summary: The capacitors can fail and allow heat to build up and the cover can eject with force from the unit, posing fire and impact hazards. Units: About 2,600.

title: Dell Recalls Hybrid Power Adapters Sold with Power Banks Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The hybrid power adapter casing can break and detach, exposing the internal metal components, posing an electric shock hazard. Units: About 8,900 (in addition, about 475 were sold in Canada).

title: DeWALT Recalls Drills Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The drill's wiring can contact internal moving parts, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 122,000 (in addition, about 8,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Children's Power Wheels Barbie Campers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The children's ride-on Power Wheels can continue to run after the foot pedal is released, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 44,000.

title: Biotouch Recalls Topical Anesthetic Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The package is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving gel contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. Units: About 8,500.

title: Clinical Resolution Laboratory Recalls Topical Anesthetic Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: 26500.

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls 12V Rechargeable Flashlights Due to Overheating and Burn Hazards
summary: The flashlight can overheat while charging, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 500,000.

title: Harbor Freight Tools Recalls Propane Torches Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The trigger on the torches that engages the flame can fail to disengage when the trigger is no longer pressed, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 150,000.

title: D&D Futon Furniture Recalls Sleeper Chair Folding Foam Beds Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattress fails to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 800.

title: JumpSport Recalls Mini Trampolines Due to Injury Hazard; New Instructions and Warning Labels Provided
summary: The folding trampoline's frame can forcefully hit the user, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 11,300 (in addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Shearwater Recalls Diving Transmitters Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The transmitters can fail to signal the tank pressure due to interference while using two transmitters in the same dive. This poses a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 900 (in addition, about 65 were sold in Canada).

title: SRAM Recalls Bicycle Gear Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The brakes in the gear hubs can fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 7,000 (in addition, 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Crate and Barrel Recalls Holiday Milk Bottles Due To Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic straw that comes with the milk bottle can crack or break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Turkey Fryer Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The turkey fryer spout can leak oil, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3000.
